entities.name: Cloud Nacatl
entities.description: Descendants of Nacatl who remained in Naya's mountains after the Breaking of the Coil.

entities.name: Wild Nacatl
entities.description: Nacatl who consider the Cloud Nacatl weak.

entities.name: Empire of the Clouds
entities.description: Former empire of the Leonin Nacatl on Naya, destroyed by internal strife.

entities.name: Claws of Marisi
entities.description: Revolutionary group that waged guerrilla war and brought the Nacatl civilization down.

entities.name: Qasal
entities.description: City that remains a Cloud Nacatl stronghold.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Alara shard where the Nacatl live.

entities.name: The Coil
entities.description: System of laws once recorded on a massive stone wall.

events.summary: The Claws of Marisi wage guerrilla war, shattering the rule of law and bringing Nacatl civilization to its knees.
events.quote: A revolutionary group known as the Claws of Marisi waged a guerrilla war, shattering the rule of law and bringing Nacatl civilization to its knees.
